_comment: INFRA-MAP-COPY-1 (2026-09-21). Authored display-copy overrides for the map pages (infrastructure.html, hub-for-hubs.html), both rendered from the derived registry data/infra-registry.json. The first pass authored ~30 overrides masking truncated/empty scraped descriptions; the root-cause pass then found the truncations were a SCRAPE bug (descOf's [^"']* class cut every description at its first apostrophe), healed the scraper, and completed the genuinely-broken heads (3 missing meta descriptions, the stale spec title, 7 em-dash titles, 5 em-dash splice descriptions) at source. With both layers fixed, every override was removed: the map pages render the source pages' own copy, cleaned only by scripts/lib/infra-map.mjs (suffix strip, em-dash-to-colon, sentence case). The mechanism stays: add a {title?, description?} entry keyed by registry path to mask a future husk that cannot be fixed at source. Keys are validated against the registry (validateOverrides) and renderDescription hard-fails on any card that would render without a description, so an empty card cannot ship. Hub-family rows get their '(N tools / N ChainGraph nodes)' phrase recomputed at render; never type a count here. Copy rules: complete sentences, no em-dashes, no comma splices (CONTRACT §1.4 + copy-hallmarks gate).
